acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode and full MS scans were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
alkylation reagent: alkylated in the dark with iodoacetamide (1200 nmol, 30 min, 25 °C)
alkylation concentration: alkylated in the dark with iodoacetamide (1200 nmol, 30 min, 25 °C)
cleavage agent: followed by addition of 100 ng proteomics-grade trypsin (Sigma-Aldrich) and digestion (5 h, 37 °C)
collision energy: normalized collision energy of 25%; HCD normalised collision energy was set at 30%
selected for CID fragmentation at normalized collision energy of 25%... In the MS3 the HCD normalised collision energy was set at 30%
fractionation method: 97.5% of the sample was further fractionated by strong cation exchange chromatography (SCX; Empore cation-SR, 3 M)
fragmentation method: selected for CID fragmentation at normalized collision energy of 25%... In the MS3 the HCD normalised collision energy was set at 30%
instrument: coupled online with a 5600 triple TOF mass spectrometer... analysed in an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer
ionization type: through a nanospray III ion source (AB Sciex)
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifiers PXD009756 and PXD009777
mass analyzer: full MS scans were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer... the detection was carried out in the linear ion trap.
precursor tolerance: MS and MS/MS tolerances of 20 ppm... Searches were performed using a peptide tolerance of 7 ppm
fragment tolerance: MS and MS/MS tolerances of 20 ppm... a product ion tolerance of 20 mmu.
ptm: Carbamidomethylation (C) fixed; oxidation (M) variable; acetylation (N-terminal) variable; DSSO modifications (K) (monolink ammonia and water quench, intra-peptide and inter-peptide crosslink) variable

Carbamidomethylation (C) was set as a fixed modification, whereas oxidation (M), acetylation (N-terminal) and DSSO modifications (K) (monolink ammonia and water quench, intra-peptide and inter-peptide crosslink) were used as variable modifications.
reduction reagent: Samples were reduced with DTT (600 nmols, 1 h, 37 °C)
reduction concentration: Samples were reduced with DTT (600 nmols, 1 h, 37 °C)
